zagg - rainier snap magsafe-compatible c.description: ZAGG's Rainier Snap MagSafe Compatible Case with Kickstand is the ultimate adventure buddy for your Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max or iPhone 17 Pro Max. This rugged, 2-part case snaps together to encase your phone in Graphene-fortified protection. Reinforced bumpers in the corners of the case provide extra defense where you need it most. The kickstand on the Rainier case holds your phone securely in portrait or landscape mode, freeing your hands so you can do more. When you’re finished, it folds back flush with the case. Rainier looks as good out on-the-town as it does on the trail with strong, statement-making accent colors. The magnetic Rainier case is MagSafe-compatible. It’s even got lanyard attach points, so you can go hands-free while keeping your phone close at-hand.
